The '''Herring''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] or on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during [[Spring]] and [[Winter]]. It can also be found randomly at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|30}} or in [[Garbage Can]]s during Spring or Winter.

Herring can be caught regardless of season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Map==
The Herring can be found in the ocean.

==Tailoring==
Herring can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Herring can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every day. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing two quests. The only possible output is blue Herring [[Roe]].

==Quests==
*'''Item Delivery:''' One Herring may be randomly requested in [[Spring]] or [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|90}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*'''Fishing:''' [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] may randomly request 1-5 herring during [[Spring]] or [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|30}} per fish.  (You get to keep the fish).
